svg.title: Shared reader credentials are removed
svg.desc: Remove the credential shape from the new-workload side with a clear revocation mark. The remaining workload boundary stays intact; access removal is narrower than deleting the workloads. Pin the sealed to its revoked state; the object silhouette persists while its status changes.
